verdict.rationale: Medusa documents a built-in customization framework for extending core commerce logic, and its marketing claims you can "extend, customize, and own every commerce workflow", so custom backend logic runs inside the platform. The evidence is generic, though: it never shows hook points, workflow hooks, or examples for discounts, shipping rules, or validation. missing for 10: documented hook/workflow-hook mechanism, concrete examples for discount/shipping/validation logic, serverless function model, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject custom backend logic — discounts, shipping rules, validation — as serverless functions or hooks that run inside the platform

citations.quote: Medusa is a commerce platform with a built-in framework for customization that allows you to build custom commerce applications without reinventing core commerce logic.
Extend, customize, and own every commerce workflow.
Guardrails for agents to build customizations.
